japanese-translation-and-tutor 1.0.0

- Initial release providing Japanese-English translation and language tutoring
- Outputs structured translations including kanji readings, vocabulary breakdowns, and cultural/grammar notes
- Enforces kanji readings in all outputs for clarity
- Adapts output formatting to platform (Slack/Discord or plain text)
- Offers explanations of formality, idioms, and cultural context on request
